provenance.source_title: Your Life as Every Rank in a Secret Society

voice_persona.name: 冷面说书人（秘社档案宣读腔）
voice_persona.description: 一个平静宣读你归属档案的叙述者：全程第二人称现在时，用短句把你从图书馆的独桌送上神话顶端；讲组织机制时像档案员一样冷静（仪式/安排/法则），写代价时把账交给物件（西装/戒指/空椅子/未寄的信）；对神秘不渲染、对权力不惊叹，让20人的长桌只有一个人坐的画面自己说话
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 把观众当作当事人本人：先让你尝到被选中与被照顾的甜，再让你看着自己一部分一部分被收走
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自组织机制的完整链条（从敲门三下到无顶设计）与判词的绝对克制

tone_profile.certainty_style: 法则用口号式确定语气（X即死亡），判词短促；神秘处反而更冷静

rhythm_rules.rule: 连续短句推进（平均7.9词，短句占60%），一个动作一句
rhythm_rules.function: 保持档案宣读式的宿命节拍

rhythm_rules.rule: 组织机制用「三拍演示」（需要→电话→一天内），动作永远无主语
法则用口号式短句颁布（可见性即死亡/失败有后果式）
代价交给物件承载（借来的西装/戒指/空椅子/未寄的信）
级间用章节卡硬切（Level X, the [身份]），身份即处境预告

pause_and_emphasis: 法则用单句成段（Visibility, they say again and again, is death.）
判词用对照句独立落下（He was never once alone. You have ruled the world and lost your own.）
章节卡后接年龄/身份定格（At 44, your reputation rises above the lodge.）
transition_style: 章节卡硬切（Level seven, the inner council.）
时间跳转声明（Two years pass while you finish your trials.）
认知升级式开场（You begin to see how the order shapes a city.）
循环回收（Somewhere tonight, a young scholarship student is studying alone.）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 极低频：全片几乎无幽默，仅组织荒诞处的冷记录
placement_rules: 组织荒诞的冷记录（他只是俱乐部？她7岁就不信）
avoid_rules: 葬礼、空椅子与信件段落保持绝对严肃

language_patterns.formula: Level X, the [身份/欲望绰号]. You are [年龄] years old.
The other students wear watches worth more than your car.
language_patterns.purpose: 用「他们的A比你的B贵」给局外人定位

language_patterns.formula: This card feels like the first thing to ever choose you.
language_patterns.purpose: 把诱惑写成第一次被选中

language_patterns.formula: Every sensible part of you says to throw the card away, but you have waited your whole life...
You realize you passed a test you never saw.
language_patterns.purpose: 写永远在进行中的评估

language_patterns.formula: Membership is a quiet kind of currency. A handshake opens a door money could not.
The world is run by rooms you were never meant to enter.
A brother needs a permit approved. A phone call is made. It is approved within a day.
language_patterns.purpose: 用无主语三拍展示隐形效率

language_patterns.formula: You memorize secrets you wish you could forget. The more you know, the less free you become.
Real power is never loud. Real power is a private number and a favor owed.
One is a father who keeps failing. The other is a master who never does.
You realize the order buried him, not his family.
You felt like a stranger over your own blood.
Visibility, they say again and again, is death.
You feel nothing as you approve the plan. You realize that feeling nothing is the point.
He never held more power than his delivery route, but he was never once alone.
None of them ever saw the spire. Neither will you.
As long as it stays sealed, the conversation is not yet finished.
language_patterns.purpose: 给拖延一个心碎的理由

language_patterns.formula: You could warn them if you wanted to. You will not. No one warned you.
They will rise. They will lead. They will arrive here alone...
language_patterns.purpose: 把主角一生压缩成下一个人的预告

avoid_traits: 神秘主义渲染（超自然暗示）
操作指南式的组织细节

forbidden_style.rule: 组织保持虚构层级，禁止影射真实会社
葬礼、空椅子与信件段落保持绝对严肃
神秘不渲染、权力不惊叹，只用机制与画面
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
